name: Valves
description: Expansion, solenoid, ball, shut-off and non-return valves.
long_description: Valves meter and control the flow of refrigerant around the system. A stuck expansion valve, a leaking solenoid or a passing check valve can cause weak cooling, flooding or pressure problems. We supply replacements matched to the refrigerant, capacity and connection size.

parts.name: Expansion valves
parts.detail: Thermostatic and electronic valves that meter refrigerant into the evaporator.
parts.summary: Expansion valves control how much refrigerant enters the evaporator, keeping the coil fully used without flooding the compressor. Thermostatic valves (TXV) work from a sensing bulb; electronic valves (EEV) are driven by the PCB.
specs: Thermostatic (TXV) with internal or external equaliser; electronic (EEV) with stepper motor
R22, R134a, R404A, R407C, R410A, R32 (valve or orifice specific to the gas)
Selected by orifice size to suit the system capacity
Flare or solder (ODF), straight or angle
12 V DC stepper coil on most AC models
Danfoss, Emerson (Alco), Sanhua, Saginomiya and others
notes: Fit the TXV bulb firmly on the suction line and insulate it
Wet-wrap the valve body when brazing to avoid heat damage

parts.name: Solenoid valves
parts.detail: Liquid line solenoid valves and coils for pump-down and flow control.
parts.summary: Solenoid valves open and close a refrigerant line electrically. They are used on liquid lines for pump-down, and on hot gas, suction and bypass lines.
specs: Normally closed (NC) as standard; normally open on request
220–240 V AC 50 Hz; 24 V AC/DC available
HCFC and HFC refrigerants (check the valve rating)
Replaceable separately from the valve body
Danfoss, Castel, Emerson, Sanhua and others
notes: Mount with the arrow in the direction of flow and the coil above the valve

parts.name: Ball valves
parts.detail: Full-bore refrigerant ball valves for isolating parts of the system.
parts.summary: Refrigerant ball valves give a quick quarter-turn shut-off with very little pressure drop. They isolate parts of the system for service without losing the whole charge.
specs: With or without a Schrader service port
Up to about 45 bar on HFC-rated valves (check rating)
notes: Keep the cap fitted: it is the secondary seal against leaks

parts.name: Hand shut-off valves
parts.detail: Manual valves for isolating lines during service and repairs.
parts.summary: Manual hand shut-off (stop) valves isolate lines, receivers and components during service. They are built for refrigerant pressures and seal tightly over many years.
specs: Manual globe-type stop valve, packed or capped stem
Brass or steel, depending on size
notes: Back-seat the valve fully open in service and refit the cap

parts.name: NRV (non-return) valves
parts.detail: Check valves that stop refrigerant flowing backwards.
parts.summary: Non-return (check) valves let refrigerant flow one way only. They prevent backflow between parallel compressors or evaporators, in heat pump circuits and on hot gas lines.
specs: Spring-loaded piston or disc check valve
Low opening differential (a fraction of a bar)
Straight-through; some types must be fitted in a set orientation
notes: Check the flow arrow and any mounting-position limits before brazing

signs: Suction pressure too low or too high
System will not pump down or hold pressure
